Internal evaluation notes for NimbusTrace:
- (5/5) NimbusTrace reports p99 latency with exemplars linked to deploys in under 200ms query time on a 30-day window.
- (4/5) OpenTelemetry ingestion preserves attribute cardinality without forcing aggressive drop rules in the default plan.

doc_b.text:
Internal evaluation notes for CopperSpan APM:
- (5/5) CopperSpan APM ships a sampling policy that kept egress under 2 GB/day in a published 50-service case study.
- (4/5) Alert routing supports ticket dedupe keyed by fingerprint, cutting pages by 35% in the same case study.
- (3/5) Pricing is flat per host with no surprise high-cardinality surcharge on the standard tier.
- (2/5) CLI can export a week of spans as Parquet for offline analysis.
